guide.item_aligator_gloves.intro: Despite the name, these gauntlets are made from the scales of swamp tentacles. They ate all the alligators years ago.
guide.item_amulet_ironbind_wizard.intro: Bound with simple runes. Forged for apprentices who learned the hard way that magic protects the spirit, but rarely the skull.
guide.item_amulet_of_adventurer.intro: A worn bracelet marked by dried blood. It holds no power. Only memory.
guide.item_amulet_of_adventurer.uses: After completing "Bells of Underkeep", hand it over to Aldren to fulfill the mission of retrieving the bracelets.
guide.item_amulet_of_embersteel.intro: A shard of Embersteel set into silver. Warm to the touch even after centuries.
guide.item_amulet_of_health.intro: Ruby stones from the silver-threaded pedestals. Temple healers once hung them around the necks of wounded soldiers.
guide.item_amulet_of_shielding.intro: A simple warding charm carried by travelers long before enchanted armor became common.
guide.item_amulet_of_sun.facts: The amount of healing received increases by 4%.
guide.item_amulet_of_sun.intro: A farewell gift from the mysterious druid. It carries the quiet warmth of the ancient grove he swore to protect.
guide.item_amulet_of_thunder.intro: Not only mages wear these. Priests carried such amulets while climbing the highest peaks to greet the first lightning of spring.
guide.item_amulet_sellsword_charm.intro: Mercenaries rarely trusted charms. Those who survived long enough usually carried one.
guide.item_ancient_ore.intro: A rare metallic stone from the moon itself. Only the best can coax Moonsteel into shape.
guide.item_ancient_ore.uses: Hand over the Brenna forged moon steel equipment. 1 piece is needed for ordinary parts, and 2 pieces are needed for the armor.
guide.item_archmages_seal.facts: Your mana consumption is reduced by 1 point.
guide.item_archmages_seal.intro: The official insignia of the Archmages' Academy. By law, no one else may wear it.
guide.item_armor_of_arrowcatcher.intro: Designed during the siege of Greywall, where archers outnumbered infantry three to one. Several arrows remain lodged between its inner plates.
guide.item_armor_of_emberspike.facts: Reacts 20% of physical melee damage as flame damage to the attacker.
guide.item_armor_of_emberspike.intro: Blackened scales studded with glowing spikes. Those who strike it quickly learn that the fire waits within the armor itself.
guide.item_armor_potion.hidden-effects: Additions of the same potion do not stack; reusing will reset the duration.
guide.item_armor_potion.hidden-effects-2: Thrown during the dialogue phase of the Marsh Leader's second stage, provides the leader with a shield that absorbs 5 points of damage.
guide.item_bandage_helmet.intro: Provides no defense, but it is great for impressing enemies with tough look.
guide.item_barbarian_helmet.intro: Once worn beneath a dying sun, when kingdoms burned and the world was shaped by strength alone.
guide.item_barbarian_helmet.uses: Return the helmet to Ronan, allowing him to open his store.
guide.item_barlo_doll.intro: There is something... disturbing about this doll.
guide.item_barlo_mushroom1.intro: Bright, warm, and suspiciously eager. It leans toward your hand as if hoping you'll pick it. Exactly the opposite of how a sensible mushroom should behave.
guide.item_barlo_mushroom1.uses: After collecting five of them, you can hand them over to Barlo for recognition. This path is mutually exclusive from the path to Swampling.
guide.item_barlo_mushroom1.uses-2: After collecting five of them, you can hand them over to Swampling at the edge of the village forest, and receive the Mushroom Bond.
guide.item_barlo_mushroom_blue.intro: Cold, unsettlingly determined. You can't shake the feeling that you weren't searching for this mushroom. This mushroom was searching for you.
guide.item_barlo_mushroom_brown.intro: A stout, soil-stained mushroom with an air of quiet authority. Picking it feels like you've just made a deal you cannot refuse.
guide.item_barlo_mushroom_green.intro: A squat, swamp-scented mushroom that radiates pure territorial energy.
guide.item_barlo_mushroom_red.intro: A plump red mushroom with a snout-like bump. When squeezed, it lets out a polite little snort.
guide.item_battle_axe.intro: Perfect for baffling foes and sending them into deep, existential crisis.
guide.item_belt_focused_breath.intro: The old masters taught that every spell begins with a single quiet breath.
guide.item_belt_of_bull.intro: Broad leather girdle bound with iron studs. It lends raw, stubborn power to every swing.
guide.item_belt_of_major_evasion.intro: Lets you evade dragons. Unless it's a black dragon.
guide.item_belt_of_marksman.intro: Fitted with loops for spare arrows and shot, this belt keeps ammunition close at hand.
guide.item_belt_of_minor_evasion.intro: Lets you evade danger. Unless the danger is a dragon.
guide.item_belt_of_second_wind.intro: Turns near death experiences into dramatic plot points.
guide.item_belt_of_sun.intro: Blessed at the Temple of Dawn. Pilgrims claimed even old wounds healed more willingly beneath its light.
guide.item_blood_hatchet.intro: Once raised only at the end of judgment, now it drinks blood without questions.
guide.item_bloodletter_dagger.hidden-eff: When actual bleeding occurs, each round causes 2–3 points of damage, with the effect lasting 4–5 rounds.
guide.item_bloodletter_dagger.intro: She sings in crimson, and her song lingers long after the blade is gone.
guide.item_blue_orb.intro: A smooth blue sphere shaped to fit an ancient mechanism.
guide.item_blue_orb.uses: Release 8 of them through the eight-hole seal door in the exterior hall of the Soul Forging furnace, to open a passage.
guide.item_bones01.intro: A bone that has clearly seen better days.
guide.item_bones01.sources: Starting equipment · Blood Mage (3 random bone items)
guide.item_bones03.intro: A perfectly ordinary bone. Completely useless, unless you're a very determined dog.
guide.item_bones05.intro: A classic headpiece... just without the rest of the body. Great for spooky decorations or improvised bowling.
guide.item_book_guardian_1: Ancient Book: The Four Who Bear the Key
guide.item_book_guardian_1.intro: "Four I chose to bear the key, four hearts bound eternally. Apart they stood, yet all as one, until the final dawn is won."
guide.item_book_guardian_3.intro: "Crowned in flame and mountain sky, none could match his watchful eye. Fire became the first great seal, where even darkness learned to kneel."
guide.item_book_guardian_4.intro: "Deep he slept where marshes lie, hidden far from mortal eye. Bog and mist became his throne, none who crossed would leave alone."
guide.item_book_guardian_5.intro: "My oldest friend beside me stood, watching village, field and wood. While tower slept beneath the sky, his silent gaze would never die."
guide.item_book_guardian_6.intro: "The greatest stood where mountains end, the final wall, the last true friend. Should every other watcher fall, his hands alone would answer all."
guide.item_book_guardian_6.uses: Referring to this book when talking to a Druid can open a conversation where they are willing to assist in investigating the collapse of the obelisks.
guide.item_boots_of_striking.intro: Boots reinforced at the toe with hardened steel. Each kick aimed to strike where it hurts most.
guide.item_boulder.intro: In the hands of a fool, it's just a rock. In the hands of a legend, it reshapes fate.
guide.item_boulder.uses: Throwing rocks into a dry well can summon the monsters hidden within it.
guide.item_bracers_leather.intro: Favored by hunters, thieves, and anyone who prefers not to get hit. They also help steady your hand when aiming.
guide.item_brass_knuckles.intro: Excellent for negotiations that have clearly failed.
guide.item_buckler.intro: This pint-sized shield might not cover much, but it's perfect for deflecting eggs and the occasional arrow.
guide.item_caerlin_blue_flowers.intro: Rare blue blossoms brimming with arcane power, said to bloom under Caerlin's night gaze.
guide.item_campbreaker.facts: Increases damage dealt to objects by 50.
guide.item_campbreaker.facts-2: Each time a enemy is killed, 2 health points are gained.
guide.item_campbreaker.intro: Favored by siege crews and mercenaries, this heavy axe was made to tear through doors, barricades, and anything hiding behind them.
guide.item_chain_armor.intro: Provides solid protection with just enough jingle to remind enemies you're coming.
guide.item_chain_boots.intro: Clank, Clank, Clank. Now you can simply walk into a tavern like you own the place.
guide.item_chain_gloves.intro: These sturdy gloves are made of interlocked steel rings, offering decent protection and a satisfying clang when you high-five someone.
guide.item_chain_helmet.intro: This sturdy headgear offers decent protection against swords, arrows, and terrible hair days.
guide.item_chieftan_axe.intro: Chipped and battle-worn, Krul'Thar still strikes fear into hearts. Too heavy for most, but in the Warrior's hands - it sings.
guide.item_cinderboots.intro: Ash still smolders along the seams. Fire clings longer to anything these boots have crossed.
guide.item_cloak_of_arcane_restoration.f: 2 health points are restored each time the spell is cast.
guide.item_cloak_of_arcane_restoration.i: Archmage Seredin completed this cloak shortly before his death. His notes describe a method of redirecting released spell energy into wounded flesh.
guide.item_cloak_of_archmage.intro: Passed between seven masters of the Archmage Academy. Each added a new spell channel to its lining.
guide.item_cloak_of_bloodspark.facts: When hit in close combat, 20% of the damage received is gained as mana.
guide.item_cloak_of_bloodspark.intro: Blood mages believe pain is merely another source of power. Every wound fuels the well of mana.
guide.item_cloak_of_dragon.intro: Sewn from scales collected from four different dragons. It shields the wearer from flame, frost, storm, and venom alike.
guide.item_cloak_of_emptiness.facts-2: The Void Mend you cast restores 2 more health.
guide.item_cloak_of_emptiness.intro: It hangs light on the shoulders, as if part of the wearer has already faded.
guide.item_cloak_of_firespark.intro: Its embroidery follows an old ignition rune used in dwarven furnaces. Fire spells bite deeper.
guide.item_cloak_of_ironveil.intro: Fine steel links are hidden between its heavy folds. Thieves found the arrangement particularly inconvenient.
guide.item_cloak_of_nature.intro: Animals see you as one of their own. Your arrows strongly disagree.
guide.item_cloak_of_striking.intro: A formal dueling cloak weighted along the hem. Masters used its movement to conceal the direction of their next strike.
guide.item_cloak_of_venomward.intro: Dyed in the bile of serpents and stitched with swamp herbs, it wards against the creeping hand of poison.
guide.item_club.intro: If you like to take out your frustration in a somewhat peculiar way, this is a good choice.
guide.item_club_thorn.intro: It's like a cactus on a stick. Painful to wield, but so satisfying when it lands a hit!
guide.item_cobra_shortsword.hidden-effec: The actual duration of poisoning depends on the target's stamina.
guide.item_cobra_shortsword.intro: Favored in the southern sands, where a poisoned blade speaks louder than a sharpened one.
guide.item_coins.sources: Items at the start of the team
guide.item_crimson_ring.intro: A dark ring marked with a single red drop. It amplifies the effects of Blood Magic.
guide.item_crown_of_lightning.intro: Crackling arcs dance across the crown's edge. It gifts the storm's wrath and hardens the bearer against its fury.
guide.item_cure_burn_or_freeze.intro: A cold tincture that chills the blood and steadies the flesh. Removes Burn and Freeze effects.
guide.item_cure_poison.intro: Now with 0% actual snake oil! Removes the Poisoned status.
guide.item_cure_stun_or_paralyze.intro: A volatile metallic elixir that can refresh the body. Removes dizziness and numbness.
guide.item_dagger.intro: The ideal weapon for anyone who wants to keep things short and sharp. Suitable for heroes with a passion for quickly slicing onions.
guide.item_damaged_flail.intro: Rusty. A spiked ball on a chain is a weapon for any chaotic adventurer who believes that aiming is overrated.
guide.item_diamond_blue.intro: A gemstone that speaks every merchant's language.
guide.item_diamond_green.intro: Classic green gem, deep, vibrant and expensive.
guide.item_diamond_purple.intro: Mysterious and quite expensive. Looks great in torchlight.
guide.item_diamond_red.intro: Surprisingly, it doesn't actually do anything... except look really expensive.
guide.item_drakkan_monk_robe.facts: When the wearer's health drops to 1 point during battle, it restores 2 health points.
guide.item_drakkan_monk_robe.intro: A tattered cloak soaked in blood magic... and possibly the last cough of its previous owner.
guide.item_drakkan_potion_blue.hidden-ef: The potion continues to be consumed even if the target is not burning or frozen.
guide.item_drakkan_potion_blue.intro: A cold elixir that cools the blood and stabilizes the body.
guide.item_drakkan_potion_unstun.hidden-: The potion continues to be consumed even if the target has no dizziness or numbness.
guide.item_drakkan_potion_unstun.intro: A volatile metallic elixir that awakens the body.
guide.item_duroks_promise.intro: Forged for Clan Durok in the deep halls of Dun Kareth. Durok never explained who the promise was made to.
guide.item_dwarf_scroll_01.intro: If you are reading this, I may not be around anymore. I have hidden the ruby where no fool would find it. It is a secret passage near the warehouse. Keep it safe, and may the stone guide your path. -Bogrin
guide.item_echo_charm.intro: A frozen charm taken from the Caerlin woods. Its wearer sometimes hears distant footsteps from beyond the grave.
guide.item_edge_of_path.intro: It is said every warrior walks a narrow path between life and death. This blade decides on which side the journey ends.
guide.item_ember_axe.intro: The edge glows faintly, even in darkness. Fire clings to the haft like it never left the forge.
guide.item_ember_gloves.intro: Forged in lava furnaces, these gauntlets glow faintly with veins of ember. Every strike sears foes with relentless fire.
guide.item_embersand_saber.intro: A finely balanced saber that leaves faint sparks in the air with every swing.
guide.item_emberskin_mitts.intro: Scorched by ancient forge heat, yet cool against the skin. They carry a faint ember's blessing against flame.
guide.item_embertrail_slippers.intro: Soft cloth lined with ember ash threads. Warm even after a winter's march.
guide.item_endurance_potion.intro: Tired of breathing heavily after just a few sword swings? Drink this stuff, and you’ll feel like you can fight a giant orc.
guide.item_eye.intro: A grotesque eye torn from the creature. You could swear it still watches you.
guide.item_feather_of_mercy.hidden-effec: Restores 1 health upon revival, but consumes a feather.
guide.item_flail.intro: A spiked ball on a chain is a weapon for any chaotic adventurer who believes that aiming is overrated.
guide.item_flower_amberrose.intro: A rare rose with golden-orange petals. Known for its calming scent and protective properties.
guide.item_flower_crimsonspire_berries.i: Tiny crimson blossoms that grow in great numbers in some regions, yet are completely absent in others.
guide.item_flower_moonpetal.intro: Flower that blooms only beneath the moon, drawing its life from moonlight rather than the sun.
guide.item_flower_solarbloom.intro: A radiant blossom that thrives in direct sunlight.
guide.item_food_apple.intro: A modest apple. No legend, no magic, just honest food.
guide.item_food_beer.intro: Best enjoyed in the tavern, worse when you wake up in the dungeon!
guide.item_food_beer.uses: Hand beer to the guard at the entrance of the Dwarf Camp in the twilight valley, and pass through gracefully.
guide.item_food_beer_dwarf.hidden-effect: Permanent flame resistance can be gained by repeatedly consuming beer.
The item tray will receive 4 units of leftover food, and 1 unit of food supply can be provided with each unit.
guide.item_food_beer_dwarf.intro: Thick as oil and twice as strong. Brewed to keep the lungs clear, the hammer steady, and the world pleasantly blurry.
guide.item_food_bread.intro: A legendary staple of adventurers since the days of Dungeon Master!
guide.item_food_bread_mold.hidden-effect: The consumer is poisoned. Each round, the base damage is 1 point, and the duration is 1–4 rounds. The actual duration is affected by stamina.
The item tray will receive 2 leftovers. Each item can provide 1 point of food replenishment.
guide.item_food_bread_mold.intro: It'll fill you up... and possibly give you a few extra surprises.
guide.item_food_chees.intro: Can be used to bribe rats.
guide.item_food_leftover.intro: Leftover bits that taste the best.
guide.item_food_major_mushroom_stew.intr: A thick bowl of mushroom stew. Smells better than it looks, but that rarely matters underground.
guide.item_food_minor_mushroom_stew.intr: A simple stew of mushrooms and whatever else the cook could find.
guide.item_food_ration.intro: Tastes like chicken. If the chicken lived in a sewer.
guide.item_food_toast.hidden-effects: Throwing in the dialogue of the Second Stage of the Marsh Leader causes the Leader to be dizzy for 3 turns.
guide.item_food_worm_slice.intro: A cut taken from the worm that ruled the deep halls. Not all meals are meant to be forgotten.
guide.item_frostbite_edge.hidden-effects: When Freezing is triggered, the basic state lasts for 1 turn.
guide.item_frostbite_edge.intro: Recovered from a glacier far beyond the northern reaches. No record identifies its maker or explains how it came to rest inside the ice.
guide.item_froststep_boots.intro: Made from the hide of northern ice cattle. Expedition records credit them with saving twelve toes and one particularly stubborn dwarf.
guide.item_generic_arrow.intro: Still sharp enough to poke an eye.
guide.item_generic_arrow.uses: Place items on stone pedestals and unlock the Runework Mechanism.
guide.item_generic_ash.intro: Fine grey ash. Cold to the touch.
guide.item_generic_balduran_medail.intro: Inscribed with a faded lion crest.
guide.item_generic_beer_bottle.intro: The glass is chipped, the smell long gone. The label, faded but just legible, reads Pizzner 12.
guide.item_generic_black_feather.intro: From a raven. Or a fallen angel.
guide.item_generic_broken_dagger.intro: You know what's worse than a rusty dagger? A broken one.
guide.item_generic_broken_wand_of_save_s: Snapped during a particularly bad reload.
guide.item_generic_charcoal_stick.intro: Perfect for writing 'I was here' on tomb walls.
guide.item_generic_coin.intro: An old copper coin with faded markings.
guide.item_generic_copper_ring.intro: Simple, worn. Round around the edges. Probably not magical.
guide.item_generic_dull_amulet.intro: Legends say it was once powerful. Legends also say many other things.
guide.item_generic_empty_djinn.intro: No genie, no wishes, just a faint smell of ozone. Maybe shake it a little... ? No, still nothing.
guide.item_generic_empty_flask_of_healin: Completely empty. Possibly licked clean by a skeleton.
guide.item_generic_giant_finger.intro: Not sure what you are supposed to do with it.
guide.item_generic_golden_tooth_of_rat_k: Golden Tooth of the Rat King
You hear scratching when you hold it to your ear.
guide.item_generic_iron_needle.intro: Too thin to sew, too painful to step on.
guide.item_generic_jar_of_mud.intro: Is it enchanted? Nope. Just mud.
guide.item_generic_metal_button.intro: A small round button, once sewn to clothing.
guide.item_generic_moss_key.intro: It's unlocked its last mystery. Probably decades ago...
guide.item_generic_nails.intro: Rusty and bent. Likely pried from an old coffin.
guide.item_generic_rusty_hook_of_butcher: When Bleeding is triggered, cause 3 damage per turn. The basic state lasts for 3 turns.
guide.item_generic_scroll_useless_wisdom: If the torch goes out, it's probably fine.
Suspicious lever definitely opens the exit.
Always split the party. That way you find more treasure.
guide.item_generic_sock_of_lich_king.int: The scent of undeath. No man can wear it and remain unchanged.
guide.item_generic_soot_cloth.intro: A piece of cloth stained with soot and ash.
guide.item_generic_tiny_coffin.intro: Now you can finally bury that ant you stepped on.
guide.item_generic_tooth.intro: Thick, cracked, and surprisingly heavy. Smells faintly of earth and mushrooms.
guide.item_generic_white_feather.intro: Symbol of peace. Or cowardice. Depends who's asking.
guide.item_giant_ash.intro: Fine grey ash from what remains of the giant. Still faintly warm with the memory of the furnace.
guide.item_giant_ash.sources: Generates after the Mechanism is triggered
guide.item_gloves_of_striking.intro: Light gloves bound with threads of tempered steel.
guide.item_gloves_of_sun.intro: High Priest Lethander wore these gloves while tending the wounded at fort Bastion. The old healing rite remains bound to their thread.
guide.item_gloves_of_walking_stars.facts: Melee attacks deal +5 points of random elemental damage.
guide.item_gloves_of_walking_stars.intro: Created by the astrologer Meren during his final and least predictable experiment. No two blows produce the same result.
guide.item_gold_chisel.intro: Gold is usually a terrible material for a chisel. This one is perfect for carving treasure out of stone.
guide.item_gold_chisel.uses: Excavate gold-rich rock walls to obtain gold ore.
guide.item_golden_ore.intro: Chunk of golden ore. Pretty shiny and expensive.
guide.item_gravecaller_bow.intro: Favored by hunters who prefer their prey already pale.
guide.item_gravemantle_cloak.intro: Burial cloth reinforced with lead thread and grave iron. Mausoleum guards once wore it beneath their armor.
guide.item_gravewrought_edge.facts: Deal +5 points of additional damage to undead enemies.
guide.item_gravewrought_edge.intro: After the Black Graves opened, every knight defending Bastion carried the same order: bury nothing until this blade had touched it first.
guide.item_great_axe.intro: Huge blade wielded by warriors who believe size matters.
guide.item_greatsword.intro: This oversized sword is as cool as it is sharp. Beware, though-it has a knack for getting stuck in ceilings, tables, and occasionally dragons.
guide.item_grgla_fish.hidden-effects: Throwing the fish during the second phase raises the swamp boss’s maximum HP to 120% of its original value.
guide.item_grgla_fish.hidden-effects-2: Wait until the boss comes to its senses, then offer it the fish in dialogue to gain 400 XP.
guide.item_grgla_fish.intro: It smells absolutely terrible. Grgla insists it's a thoughtful gift.
guide.item_grgla_fish.uses: You can give the fish to the swamp boss during the first phase of its dialogue.
guide.item_grgla_fish.uses-2: Throw the fish in the second phase, or give it to the boss after it comes to its senses.
guide.item_hand_axe.intro: It may not be shiny, but it gets the job done.
guide.item_hardened_armor.intro: Leather armor reinforced with metal plates. Perfect for when you need to look tough while still being able to take a nap.
guide.item_hat_of_archmage.facts: Your spell costs 2 points of mana less.
guide.item_hat_of_archmage.intro: An ancient hat stitched with sigils no modern scholar fully understands. It must have belonged to a mage of immense power.
guide.item_hat_of_fire.intro: A scorched brim lined with fire runes. A gift from the dwarves, though they still charged for it.
guide.item_hat_of_winter.facts: Frost spells have a higher chance of freezing
guide.item_hat_of_winter.intro: Made of frosty wool. The air around the brim of the hat turns white, and every breath carries the scent of endless winter.
guide.item_hat_of_wisdom.intro: A worn hood that stills the mind and draws in a faint current of arcane energy.
guide.item_hatchet.intro: Perfect for when you need to really convince someone you're serious... about cutting down trees.
guide.item_heal_potion.hidden-effects: Throwing during the second phase of the swamp leader's dialogue restores 10 health points per turn for the leader.
guide.item_heal_potion.intro: Side effects may include existential crisis when you realize how many of these you've chugged.
guide.item_heavy_crossbow.intro: Great range and devastating power. Comes with a free arm workout.
guide.item_helm_of_bull.intro: Heavy and unyielding, this helm bears the strength of the beast it honors. Its weight alone makes lesser men stagger.
guide.item_helm_of_dominance.intro: Worn by Marshal Ordan while suppressing the Mimic rebellion. The mind within suffers neither frost nor daze.
guide.item_helm_of_striking.intro: Its narrow visor was designed by the duelists of Lerwick to keep the eye fixed on an opponent's exposed points.
guide.item_helmet_of_lucky_farsight.fact: Ranged attacks are Lucky (each attack has two damage rolls, and the higher one wins).
guide.item_helmet_of_lucky_farsight.intr: The archer Selwyn wore this helm during the King's Tournament and struck every target before it was fully raised.
guide.item_huntsman_sling.intro: A leather loop that teaches goblins about distance.
guide.item_ingredient_ectoplasm.intro: A cold, pearly residue that slips through gloves and reason. Alchemists prize it for phasing draughts and spirit wards.
guide.item_ingredient_mandibles.intro: Hooked chitinous jaw from a blood-drinking beetle. Useful for venom tinctures.
guide.item_ingredient_mimic_heart.intro: A mimic's heart, prized by alchemists for its unsettling vitality.
guide.item_iron_knuckles.intro: A little extra iron for when your fist isn't making a convincing enough argument.
guide.item_iron_shield.intro: This sturdy hunk of metal is perfect for blocking swords, arrows, and your party's terrible decisions.
guide.item_ironveil_armor.intro: Fine steel plates are hidden beneath cloth. More than one assassin discovered them too late.
guide.item_jacob_hand_axe.intro: The axe fits perfectly in the hand. The letter J is engraved on the handle.
guide.item_jacob_hand_axe.uses: After rescuing Jacob, return the axe to him.
guide.item_jacob_scroll_01.intro: The forest has grown darker and more dangerous of late. Be wary as you tread these paths. I have left some healing potions here for those in need. I trust they will serve you well. Not far from here, I have also hidden my trusty axe. Should your journey take you near my cabin on the western edge of the woods, do stop by. All travelers are welcome. -J
guide.item_jacob_scroll_02.intro: If you have found this, then I am already gone. The whispers in the dark have returned, and the village is not safe. Something ancient stirs beneath our feet, and I must uncover the truth before it is too late. Seek Khelebar in the village. He will know more. But be warned... the shadows have eyes, and they are watching. Jacob
guide.item_jacob_scroll_03.intro: Tonight I enter. I've watched them for days. Bloody figures moving through the fog. They speak of the Source. I'm certain now it lies behind the disappearances and blood rites. If I do not return, follow my trail, but tread carefully. May the wilds watch over you. Jacob
guide.item_key_garden.intro: A slender silver key adorned with a curling leaf motif.
guide.item_key_garden.uses: Operate the silver lock of the garden gate in the lost garden hall.
guide.item_key_hc1_gold.intro: An ornate golden key, cold to the touch. Its head bears the sigil of Maltherion, once High Cleric of blood and ice.
guide.item_key_hc1_gold.uses: Operate the triple gold lock in the cells of the forgotten ones, requiring the collection of three priests’ golden keys.
guide.item_key_hc2_gold.intro: A heavy, timeworn golden key streaked with green patina. It belonged to Thalric, the High Cleric who cloaked himself in flame.
guide.item_key_hc3_gold.intro: A dark-gilded key with jagged teeth. Its design whispers of Zerethic, High Cleric of silence and blood.
guide.item_key_iron_dungeon.intro: Found deep underground. It will fit some lock for sure.
guide.item_key_iron_dungeon.uses: Operate the iron lock deep within the soul forging furnace, opening the connected doors or fences.
guide.item_key_iron_infected.intro: A worn iron key carried by one of the infected miners.
guide.item_key_iron_infected.uses: Operate the iron lock of the mineway, opening the connected doors.
guide.item_key_iron_moss.uses: Operate the corresponding lock to open the locked door or box.
guide.item_key_lantern.intro: The emerald is probably worth more than whatever this key unlocks. Isn't it?
guide.item_key_lantern.uses: Open the locked treasure box in the white birch forest.
guide.item_key_lockpick.intro: A small set of finely shaped tools used to open stubborn locks.
guide.item_key_silver.uses: Operate the silver lock of the mine to open the connected doors.
guide.item_khelebar_amulet.intro: Khelebar claimed wisdom should be carried quietly. The amulet rarely left his neck.
guide.item_knight_shield.intro: It doubles as a convenient table for your lunch during a break from battle.
guide.item_lantern.intro: A silver-framed lantern said to reveal or bind restless souls. Its light burns cold and steady, untouched by wind.
guide.item_lantern.uses: Use the lantern at the charred, unmarked grave to summon the spirit guardian.
guide.item_leather_boots.intro: Crafted from tough leather, these boots are perfect for running from monsters.
guide.item_leather_brigandine.intro: A sturdy armor made from leather. Great for sneaky adventurers or anyone who needs to look cool while taking a few hits!
guide.item_leather_gloves.intro: Made from the finest leather-perfect for punching, or just looking mysteriously cool.
guide.item_leather_helmet.intro: Not much protection, but at least your head won't get sunburned!
guide.item_light_crossbow.intro: Point and click. When you want to be deadly accurate but don't have time for all that tedious sword-dancing.
guide.item_longbow.intro: Ideal when your enemies are just too far to shout at.
guide.item_longbow_jacob.intro: The longbow bears the weight of a hundred hunts, its yew hardened by years of sunlight.
guide.item_longbow_striking.intro: A finely crafted longbow with limbs of dark yew and silver-inlaid runes along the grip.
guide.item_longsword.intro: Because sometimes, bigger is better. Especially when it's for swinging at things.
guide.item_longsword_void.intro: This blade once rested in the grasp of a Skeleton King and it remembers centuries of hollow victories.
guide.item_lucille_full_game.hidden-effe: When bloodshed is triggered, it causes 5 damage per round, and the effect lasts for 3 rounds.
guide.item_lucille_full_game.intro: A heavy wooden club wrapped in barbed wire. Near the handle, a single name is carved in shaky letters: \Negan.\
guide.item_mace.intro: A surprisingly polite weapon that delivers a solid whack with a side of charm.
guide.item_mace_of_grave.intro: It was forged to strike the divine. A weapon of rebellion, anointed in silence. But the Void turned inward, consuming its purpose.
guide.item_mace_of_stars.facts: Each hit causes 3 random elemental damage.
guide.item_mace_of_stars.intro: They say it was forged by a titan who ruled sky and storm. The ages have dimmed its fury, but not extinguished it.
guide.item_mace_stagger.hidden-effects: When dizziness is triggered, it lasts for 1 round.
guide.item_mace_stagger.intro: Designed for fighting armored opponents. The head is weighted heavily enough to stagger a man even when the plate holds.
guide.item_mana_potion.intro: Drink up and keep those spells flying!
guide.item_mana_up_potion.hidden-effects: The same character can drink repeatedly and stack the maximum mana capacity. When used by characters without mana, the potion will still be consumed.
guide.item_marksman_bracers.facts: Causes an additional 2 points of damage to animals.
guide.item_marksman_bracers.intro: Bracers favored by hunters of the wild. They guide the shot and strike truer against beasts that roam beyond the roads.
guide.item_maul.intro: A massive warhammer forged from hard stone and the crushed dreams of overly confident adventurers.
guide.item_mega_heal_potion.intro: Heals a lot. Like, a suspicious amount.
guide.item_mindstep_sandals.facts: Unarmed attacks gain damage equal to the wearer's wisdom.
guide.item_mindstep_sandals.intro: Worn by the debating monks of Orrem, who settled arguments with equal parts philosophy and violence.
guide.item_mine_chest_key.uses: Open the locked treasure chest in the mine.
guide.item_miner_helmet.intro: Protects against heat while you're digging your way to riches... or a very hot, molten doom.
guide.item_miner_message_01.intro: Something crawls inside my skull. Visions twist before my eyes, shapes that are not there. The voices speak now. They call me deeper, promising rest, promising silence. I don't know if I have the strength to turn back. The others went further down.
guide.item_miner_message_02.intro: I used all the dynamite. The tunnels are rubble now and with them, my two friends. Gods forgive me. I don't know if it will hold. The thing we woke is worse than death, and it spreads. Don't come further. No treasure, no ore is worth this. -Juran
guide.item_miners_gloves.intro: Heavy work gloves hardened by dust, sweat, and years in the tunnels.
guide.item_minor_endurance_potion.intro: Drinking it grants a boost to stamina, helping you push beyond your limits.
guide.item_minor_heal_potion.sources-3: Starting equipment · The Flow of Life
guide.item_minor_heal_potion.uses: Place items in the corresponding wall niches to activate the mechanism.
guide.item_minor_mana_potion.intro: When your magical abilities are just a little bit thirsty.
guide.item_monk_tunic.facts: Your armor is equal to dexterity / 2. Other Armor bonuses are ignored.
guide.item_monk_tunic.intro: The monks of the Silent Step wore no armor beneath these tunics. They believe the body itself is the strongest fortress.
guide.item_moonsteel_armor.facts: Each type of limited forge can be used once. The dialogue requires having 100 gold coins, and 50 gold coins are actually deducted.
guide.item_moonsteel_armor.intro: Forged from Moonsteel, the rarest metal known to dwarven smiths. Even the smallest fragment is worth a fortune.
guide.item_moonsteel_boots.intro: Forged from the same star alloy as the legendary Moonsteel Armor, these boots weigh heavy as anchors yet stride as giants.
guide.item_moonsteel_gloves.intro: Even a small amount of Moonsteel was enough to turn ordinary gauntlets into family heirlooms.
guide.item_moonsteel_helmet.facts-2: Each type can be forged only once
guide.item_moonsteel_helmet.intro: They say moonlight once struck the mountain where this helm was forged, and a shard of that radiance still lingers within.
guide.item_moonsteel_shield.intro: Forged from metal that fell from the night sky. No finer shield has ever stood under the sky and none has ever broken.
guide.item_mortar.intro: Use it to crush herbs and other dungeon ingredients into potions, stews, and experimental mixtures.
guide.item_mortar.uses: Use the Mortar and Pestle in the item section. Place the materials required for the recipe to synthesize them.
guide.item_mushroom1.intro: A small wild mushroom that seems to grow just about anywhere. It shows no obvious properties, though some adventurers swear it may hide a purpose.
guide.item_mushroom_blue.intro: This pale blue fungus hums faintly with unstable energy. Alchemists value it highly, though careless handling has ended more than one experiment badly.
guide.item_mushroom_green.intro: A pungent mushroom that reeks of stale alcohol. Adventurers often sniff it out. Occasionally, so do monsters.
guide.item_mushroom_green.uses: Gather 10 flowers and give them to Brenna for brewing.
guide.item_mushroom_red.hidden-effects: Throwing during the second stage of the swamp leader's dialogue will blind the leader for 3 turns and reduce its hit rate.
guide.item_mushroom_red.intro: Red cap, white spots. A classic. Textbooks say do not eat.
guide.item_nightsting_dagger.hidden-effe: When the poison is triggered, it causes 2–3 points of damage per turn, and the duration depends on the target's stamina.
guide.item_nightsting_dagger.intro: A dagger favored by assassins. Its edge is etched with venom grooves, meant to carry poison deep into the wound.
guide.item_oath_of_bastion.intro: One of the legendary blades forged for the knights who swore to defend Bastion until their final breath.
guide.item_orc_bandit_chest_key.uses: Open the treasure chest in the bandit camp.
guide.item_orc_chest_key.intro: Unlocks the chieftain's treasure chest. It may include gold, bones, or one deeply confused goblin.
guide.item_orc_chest_key.uses: Open the treasure chest of the Orc Chieftain.
guide.item_pickaxe.intro: A trusty tool for digging, smashing, and pretending you're a dwarf.
guide.item_pickaxe.uses: Survey the rim of the dry well and extract gold coins hidden in the stone crevices using a hook.
guide.item_pickaxe_hard.intro: Cuts through the toughest stone without breaking a sweat.
guide.item_pickaxe_hard.uses: Break through hard blocks that cannot be cleared with ordinary hooks.
guide.item_plate_armor.intro: Plate armor turns you into a walking fortress. Perfect for tanking hits, but not compliments.
guide.item_plate_boots.intro: Cool for warriors who prefer to crush their enemies AND their toes with every step.
guide.item_plate_gloves.intro: Excellent protection comes with a slight downside: everything you hold feels just a little off.
guide.item_plate_helmet.intro: Not only does it provide top-notch protection against incoming blows, but it also gives you a suitably intimidating look.
guide.item_potion_cure_poison.hidden-eff: Even if the target is not poisoned, the potion will still be consumed.
guide.item_potion_cure_poison.intro: Now it contains 0% real snake oil!
guide.item_potion_heal_and_endurance.hid: When used on characters without stamina, it can still restore health.
guide.item_potion_heal_and_mana.hidden-e: When used on characters without mana, it can still restore health.
guide.item_potion_poison.hidden-effects: When consumed, the poison causes 2 base damage per turn, with a base duration of 4 turns. The actual duration is affected by stamina.
guide.item_potion_poison.hidden-effects-: Throwing in the dialogue of the second stage of the Marsh Leader will instead poison the entire team. It causes 3 base damage per turn, with a base duration of 5 turns.
guide.item_potion_resurrection.facts: Revives a fallen hero with 1 point of health.
guide.item_potion_resurrection.intro: In every drop, echoes the heartbeat of a forgotten hero.
guide.item_quarterstaff.intro: The steadfast companion of more than just magicians. Use it to knock some sense into your enemies.
guide.item_quarterstaff_plus_one.intro: A seasoned staff reinforced with subtle runes. Its balance is steady, its strike carries a touch more weight than common wood.
guide.item_ranger_dagger.intro: A hunter's blade. Light, quiet, and perfect for anyone who prefers to solve animal encounters with precision rather than diplomacy.
guide.item_recipe_armor_potion.intro: A thick, bitter brew that hardens the skin and steadies the stance. Favored by heroes expecting trouble.
guide.item_recipe_ele_resist_potion.intr: A protective brew that dulls the bite of flame, frost, and lightning.
guide.item_recipe_evasion_potion.intro: A light, sharp potion that quickens the reflexes. Blades seem to miss by a hair.
guide.item_recipe_item_food_toast.intro: Bread piled with mushroom, ham, and cheese, then crisped over the fire. Dungeon comfort food.
guide.item_recipe_minor_mushrom_stew.int: A fragment of culinary knowledge. It describes the ingredients and preparation needed to create a nourishing stew.
guide.item_recipe_perma_mana.intro: A rare and potent distillation of Caerlin Blossoms that expands the mind's arcane reserves.
guide.item_recipe_poison.intro: Guaranteed to make someone's day significantly worse.
guide.item_recipe_resurect.intro: In every drop echoes the heartbeat of forgotten heroes. Revives a fallen hero with 1 HP.
guide.item_recipe_toast.intro: A fragment of culinary knowledge. It describes the ingredients and preparation needed to create a nourishing meal.
guide.item_red_mask.facts: When not using bone spells, consumes 1 less point of health.
guide.item_red_mask.intro: A ritual mask stained deep red, worn by those who bargain with blood. It eases the toll when the price must be paid in flesh.
guide.item_respec_potion.intro: Forget everything you've learned. Don't worry, you get to make the same mistakes all over again.
guide.item_ring_beastbane.intro: A simple copper band marked with tiny claw symbols.
guide.item_ring_marksman_signet.intro: A finely crafted band engraved with runes of precision. When aiming, the hand grows steady and the target seems a little less lucky.
guide.item_ring_of_bull.facts-2: There is another abandoned cave located outside the map range (18, -51).
guide.item_ring_of_bull.intro: Thick and heavy, carved in the likeness of horns. Champions wear these rings before entering the arena.
guide.item_ring_of_corpsebane.facts: Inflicts an additional +3 damage on Undead enemies.
guide.item_ring_of_corpsebane.intro: Forged from old coffin nails. The dead seem deeply offended by it.
guide.item_ring_of_elemental_res.intro: Set with four stones: emberstone, frost crystal, stormglass, and green jade.
guide.item_ring_of_firespark.intro: Tiny embers flicker within the metal. Flames follow the wearer's will, eager to ignite flesh and bone.
guide.item_ring_of_gravebane.intro: Blackened silver, packed once with grave soil. It bites deeper into things that should have stayed buried.
guide.item_ring_of_lightning_bolt.intro: A crackling band etched with storm sigils. Wear with caution during thunderstorms.
guide.item_ring_of_major_evasion.intro: Master thieves call it insurance. City guards call it a problem.
guide.item_ring_of_minor_evasion.intro: Slightly better than just closing your eyes and hoping for the best!
guide.item_ring_of_minor_health.intro: Plain metal wrapped around a living red stone. Warm to the touch, as if a tiny heartbeat still lingers inside.
guide.item_ring_of_minor_mana.intro: A cool sapphire coil that quiets the mind and leaves a little more room for magic.
guide.item_ring_of_monk.intro: Passed from master to student for generations. Ownership was never part of the tradition.
guide.item_ring_of_poison_reistance.intr: Because licking suspicious frogs should be a hobby, not a death sentence.
guide.item_ring_of_ranger_guard.facts: Cause an additional +2 damage to Undead enemies.
guide.item_ring_of_ranger_guard.intro: It was worn on the borders, where the fallen walk and silence kills. Rangers say the dead cannot surprise you if you never stop listening.
guide.item_ring_of_scarlet_wounds.facts: Whenever you apply Bleed, it deals %1 more damage per round.
guide.item_ring_of_scarlet_wounds.intro: Cuts made while wearing it tend to bleed longer than they should.
guide.item_ring_of_striking.intro: Highly prized by thieves and assassins. Most wear one. The clever ones wear two.
guide.item_ring_of_whisper.intro: Its surface is perfectly smooth and you can sometimes hear silent whispering.
guide.item_ring_of_wind.facts: When full health, increases melee and ranged damage by 2 points.
guide.item_ring_of_wind.intro: Light as air, restless as a storm. It sharpens every strike when the body stands unbroken.
guide.item_ring_of_wisdom.intro: Wisdom takes years of study. Or one good ring.
guide.item_ring_spell_focus.intro: Simple in appearance. Every archmage eventually owned one.
guide.item_runeguard_tunic.intro: Issued to the dwarves of Dun Kareth. Every stitch follows the pattern of an old protective ward.
guide.item_rusty_chain_boots.intro: Rusty. Clank, Clank, Clank. That's a sound you can't hear in rusty boots.
guide.item_rusty_dagger.intro: Rusty. The ideal weapon for anyone who wants to keep things short and sharp. Suitable for heroes with a passion for quickly slicing onions.
guide.item_rusty_great_axe.intro: Rusty. Huge blade wielded by warriors who believe size matters.
guide.item_rusty_hand_axe.intro: Rusty. It may not be shiny, but it gets the job done.
guide.item_rusty_longsword.intro: Rusty. Because sometimes, bigger is better-especially when it's for swinging at things.
guide.item_rusty_scale_helmet.intro: Rusty. Perfect for heroes who want to scale new heights of style and protection!
guide.item_rusty_sword.intro: Rugged. Fits perfectly into your backpack, and can even fit between enemy ribs!
guide.item_sandals.intro: Wear at your own risk of being too cool for the dungeon!
guide.item_scale_armor.intro: Flexible, tough, and perfect for those who want to look like they're ready for battle.
guide.item_scale_boots.intro: Light enough to dance, tough enough to survive your worst battle tactics.
guide.item_scale_gloves.intro: These gloves offer decent defense and a chance to look slightly cooler than the average adventurer.
guide.item_scale_helmet.intro: Perfect for heroes who want to scale new heights of style and protection!
guide.item_scimitar.intro: If you want your swordplay to be as dramatic as your entrance!
guide.item_scoutwind_boots.intro: Standard equipment among the scouts of the northern passes. Their soles leave little trace, even in wet ground.
guide.item_scroll_hidden_treasure_c.intr: If you are reading this, then I did not make it back. I did not trust earth or roots to keep my coin safe. On the clearing between the rocks lies a fallen tree, split and hollowed by time. Within its dark opening, I left what little I had left to my name.
guide.item_scroll_hidden_treasure_d.intr: The old tales spoke true. There is something buried in these caves. Gold, relics, perhaps more. I followed the markings deeper than the others dared. Too deep. Now I hear only the footsteps of my dead companions echoing through the dark... and something else behind them. - Durgan
guide.item_scroll_michael_hint.intro: A brittle parchment speaks of a wish-bearing tree-one that grants truth, never lies. Carve your real name, he writes, and be blessed. Carve a false one... and face a fate he dares not describe. Michael
guide.item_scroll_riddle_hint1.intro: Second breath of the tower's song, where runes of silence still belong.
guide.item_scroll_riddle_hint2.intro: Fifth echo in the crypts below, where candles die yet embers glow.
guide.item_scroll_summon_name.intro: The parchment crackles faintly, as if resisting the ink itself. Twisted glyphs crawl along its surface, surrounding a single name etched deeper than the rest. Ixarion.
guide.item_scroll_summon_name.uses: Perform the ritual in the pentagram formation, summon Iksarion with the scroll and true name.
guide.item_scroll_surroudnings_hint.intr: A roof of three. A single pillar beneath.
guide.item_scroll_underkeep_letter.intro: If this letter has reached you, make your way to Underkeep. I have need of capable people. Should you accept, I believe your journey will prove worthwhile. -M.
guide.item_scroll_underkeep_letter_blood: The parchment is torn and stained with dried blood. Several lines are missing. ... make your way to Underkeep. I have need of capable people. You will be rewarded beyond your expectations. Do not delay. -M.
guide.item_scroll_village_hint.intro: A rough, dirt-stained note written in a harsh, deliberate hand. It speaks of the village's western flank. Weak, thinly guarded, ripe for a strike. The writer urges the orc leader to gather his warriors beneath the ridge and wait for a signal. The plunder will be worth the blood if you do exactly as instructed. No questions. No hesitation. Bring your axes! - M.
guide.item_scroll_village_hint.uses: Present the bandits' orders to the village chief Aldren, and advance the project "Bells of Underkeep."
guide.item_scroll_west_garden_hint1.intr: The Cycle's Whisper When buds awake and rains begin, Then golden sun warms life within. Next crimson leaves in sorrow fall, Then silent frost will end it all.
guide.item_scroll_west_garden_hint2.intr: Not mirrored, not turned, but placed as their distant kin stand. Seek the same corner beyond these grounds. The other garden will show the way.
guide.item_shaman_wrap.intro: Layers of ritual cloth soaked in herbs and bitter resins. Slows the body, but shields the wearer from poison, frost, and attempts to still the mind.
guide.item_shield_of_arrowcatcher.intro: Built for soldiers assigned to the front rank during sieges. Its face is thick enough to stop a crossbow bolt at twenty paces.
guide.item_shield_of_lethander.facts: The amount of healing magic you cast increases by 2%.
guide.item_shield_of_lethander.intro: Once carried by Lethander, who healed the dying upon the battlefield of Ashen Fields. The shield still bears his blessing, its surface glowing faintly with hymns etched into steel.
guide.item_shield_of_protection.intro: Recovered from the gatehouse after the fall of Bastion. Enchantments etched deep into the iron are still very strong.
guide.item_shield_of_wind.facts: At full health, +3 points of melee and ranged damage.
guide.item_shield_of_wind.intro: A dueling shield from the courts of Valen. Its enchantment responds only while the bearer remains unwounded.
guide.item_short_sword.intro: A sword just long enough to hit the enemy, but not the friend who stands next to him.
guide.item_shortbow.intro: Perfect for when you want to shoot low but still pack a punch!
guide.item_shovel.intro: A sturdy iron shovel, its edge dulled by years of toil. Useful for breaking ground or disturbing what should have stayed buried.
guide.item_skyshot_bracers.intro: Favored by the archers of the Far Reaches. Magical markings depict constellations, helping them judge the elevation and distance of their targets.
guide.item_sleepers_staff.intro: Carved from a coffin plank of Sleeper monster. It listens for heartbeats, and answers only when blood is spilled.
guide.item_sling.intro: Perfect for pelting goblins, knocking apples out of trees, or ruining an unsuspecting ogre's lunch break.
guide.item_sling_splintered_aim.facts: There is a 20% chance of hitting two enemies at the same time.
guide.item_sling_splintered_aim.intro: The crack of the shot splits the air, lightning leaping from one foe to the next.
guide.item_soulforge_axe: Soulcleaver, Axe of the Deep Forge
guide.item_soulforge_axe.description: An unstoppable force of the Void drives the target one step backward.
guide.item_soulforge_axe.intro: The Void was bound. This is not just a weapon; it is a legend. Firstborn of the Soulforge.
guide.item_soulforge_axe.uses: After defeating the tower wizard, possessing this axe can trigger the ending branch related to the Soul Forge.
guide.item_spear.intro: The oldest battlefield lesson is letting the enemy meet the point before they reach you.
guide.item_spider_eye.intro: Plucked from a spider that no longer needs it.
guide.item_spike_cloak.facts: Rebound 20% physical melee damage to the attacker.
guide.item_spike_cloak.intro: Soft on the inside, lined with hidden spikes on the outside. Those who strike too close learn which side was meant to bleed.
guide.item_spiked_armor.intro: Brutal and crude, bristling with iron thorns. Offers excellent protection and strongly discourages hugging.
guide.item_spiritweave_gloves.facts: Healing from spells you cast is increased by %1.
guide.item_spiritweave_gloves.intro: Temple healers wore these gloves while tending the wounded.
guide.item_staff_of_archmage.intro: Wrought from elderwood, the staff bends the weave of magic. To its bearer, every spell whispers more softly, demanding less of their strength.
guide.item_staff_of_fireball.description: Shoots a ball of fire that detonates in a small radius.
guide.item_staff_of_fireball.intro: This staff comes with built-in fireballs. No assembly required.
guide.item_staff_of_ice_crystals.descrip: Shoots a razor-sharp shard of enchanted ice.
guide.item_staff_of_ice_crystals.intro: Perfect for freezing foes or keeping your drink chilled on long dungeon crawls.
guide.item_staff_of_stars.intro: Astronomers argued for decades whether the carvings matched the heavens. None reached the same conclusion.
guide.item_staff_of_thunder.description: Now you can occasionally unleash a Lightning bolt at your enemies.
guide.item_staff_of_thunder.intro: Makes hair stand up and enemies lie down.
guide.item_stormcleaver.intro: Raised upon the highest tower of the Archmage Academy, nine bolts of natural lightning were bound within its steel.
guide.item_sword.intro: Fits perfectly in your backpack, and also into the ribs of enemies!
guide.item_sword_of_striking.intro: A dueling blade, balanced for the wrist and sharpened for gaps no wider than a coin.
guide.item_sword_shardpiercer.facts: Each target has a negative effect, providing +2 base damage.
guide.item_sword_shardpiercer.intro: Veyra the Black carried Shardpiercer through seven kingdoms before the bounty hunters finally caught her. Every kill was made by this blade.
guide.item_tattered_robe.intro: This worn-out robe has seen more battles than most adventurers.
guide.item_teleport_stone.intro: A worn shard of unknown origin. Waystones seem to respond to its presence as if aware of distant places waiting to be reached.
guide.item_teleport_stone.uses: Holding the Teleportation Stone and operating the Road Stone allow movement between fast travel points.
guide.item_thunder_gloves.facts: Lightning spells are Lucky (each attack has two damage rolls, and the higher one wins).
guide.item_thunder_gloves.intro: Their maker claimed the lightning was safely contained. His workshop burned down during the first demonstration.
guide.item_torren_tincture.hidden-effect: Throwing in the second stage of the swamp leader conversation can reduce the leader's health by 40% of the maximum value and grant 40 experience points.
When throwing at a floating Wizard, the potion will be blocked by the barrier and consumed.
guide.item_torren_tincture.intro: A thick, murky green liquid. Almost certainly some form of poison.
guide.item_torren_tincture.uses: When encountering Torren again around the tower, you can show him the small bottle.
guide.item_torren_tincture.uses-2: In the second stage of the conversation with the swamp leader, you can choose to throw this item.
guide.item_torren_tincture.uses-3: In the conversation when the wizard first appears, you can choose to throw items towards the wizard.
guide.item_trader_key_iron.uses: Open the merchant's private treasure chest.
guide.item_underkeep_key_1.intro: Its edge jagged where it once joined the whole. Ancient glyphs shimmer faintly along the curve.
guide.item_underkeep_key_1.uses: Insert this rune fragment into the corresponding groove at the tower gate. Only when all four pieces are inserted will the gate open.
guide.item_venom_sac.intro: A small sac filled with potent venom. Handle with care.
guide.item_viperstrike_dagger.hidden-eff: When triggered, cause 3 damage per turn. The effect lasts for 6 turns, and the duration is affected by the target's endurance.
guide.item_viperstrike_dagger.intro: A single cut. Quick. Quiet. Efficient.
guide.item_void_dagger.intro: It is said it comes from the First Silence. Its edge is impossibly thin and rare.
guide.item_voidshard.hidden-effects: When used on characters without magic power, fragments will still be consumed.
guide.item_voidshard.hidden-effects-2: Throwing in the dialogue of the second stage of the Marsh Leader will permanently apply the "Void Shard Effect" to the leader.
guide.item_voidshard.intro: A crystalline shard infused with void essence. It fractures upon use, unleashing a burst of raw mana.
guide.item_voidshard.uses: The Soul Warden can be summoned using fragments from the charred nameless tombs. This process consumes fragments.
guide.item_warehouse_chest_key.uses: Open the locked treasure chest in the mine warehouse.
guide.item_whispering_armor.intro: The joints are lined with enchanted silk instead of leather. Its subtle enchantments sharpen movement, granting the wearer swifter reflexes.
guide.item_whispering_boots.intro: Their soles barely touch the ground. Soft leather is lending silence to every stride.
guide.item_whispering_gloves.intro: Their silk shifts before the hand begins to move. The assassins of House Valen were said to wear them beneath their formal gloves.
guide.item_wild_berries.intro: Tart, slightly sweet, and easy to miss until your stomach reminds you.
guide.item_withered_rose.facts: On critical hit, leeches 35% of the damage dealt as health.
guide.item_withered_rose.intro: Once a blade of noble steel, now dulled and veined like a dying petal. Legends whisper it was once a wedding gift, steel blackened after it killed the bride.
guide.item_wolf_head.intro: Cold bone, empty eyes. Yet something still watches from within.
guide.item_wolf_head.uses: Place the Wolf Skull back at the Kaelin Wolf statue, and open the hidden passage.
guide.item_wolf_tooth.intro: A cracked canine taken from a fallen wolf. Still sharp, still stained, and prized by hunters as proof of a close kill.
